model.name: R19.27: Clicking the icon once collapses item width to a perfect square with the icon inside, height unchanged.
model.description: When the user clicks/taps the icon of an rb-object-item once, the item MUST collapse its WIDTH to a perfect square (the icon centered inside) while keeping its HEIGHT unchanged. This is a compact/minimized view state toggled by icon-tap. A second tap on the icon restores the full-width layout (icon + name + description visible).
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "clicking the icon once shall collapse the width of the item to a perfect square with the icon inside but keep the height."
